comments.content: STALL RETEST — HALTED + CLEANED UP (orchestrator-direct; the agent's observation loop was lagging my stop). Halted rather than continued; awaiting explicit operator direction on whether headless kickoff dispatch may run gate-disabled at all. SUBSTANTIVE FINDING (the retest's real yield, before halt): the local-path stall is a TWO-DIALOG structure. Dialog 1 = bypass-permissions, cleared by --skip-permissions (PR #72). Dialog 2 = the PATH-SCOPED PROJECT-TRUST prompt, triggered by the tracked .claude/settings.json pre-approvals (Bash(tmux *), Bash(git worktree *)) and re-raised on EVERY fresh kickoff worktree — structural, NOT cleared by --skip-permissions. So #55/#837 is only half-addressed by the merged fixes for THIS repo's config shape: the flag clears layer 1, layer 2 re-parks every headless launch. This matches the contract's own Trust-boundaries note ('project trust — path-scoped, so fresh worktrees re-raise it on attended vehicles'). VERDICT: STALL-PERSISTS via dialog 2 (a distinct mechanism from the container-side fixes). Entry-1 resolution is therefore NOT grounded — the manual-dispatch fallback stands, correctly; its trigger_context updated to name the dialog-2 structural blocker as a distinct condition from upstream #55.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: #55 REFINED DIAGNOSIS (fork's controlled investigation, dollspace-gay/crosslink#55, 2026-08-02 04:11) — materially sharper AND corrects our retest attribution: (1) THE STALL IS TTY-SPECIFIC. Container path (kickoff run --container) WORKS headless: docker run -d = no TTY = the interactive folder-trust dialog cannot render = --skip-permissions proceeds (verified end-to-end against a genuinely untrusted mount, exit 0). Only the tmux path (kickoff plan, local kickoff run) stalls (interactive PTY renders the dialog). (2) CORRECTION to our finding: the blocking dialog is claude's FOLDER-TRUST prompt, TTY-gated, firing on ANY untrusted fresh-worktree path — NOT the settings-pre-approval variant we named (REFUTED: an empty dir with no settings still prompts). Only writing hasTrustDialogAccepted clears it; claude upgrades (2.1.213-220) trend STRICTER (2.1.218 gates agent-hooks on trust; the SDK's register_repo_root at 2.1.219 is unreachable from the kickoff CLI). (3) RESOLUTION FOR OUR CONSENT-POSTURE QUESTION: container dispatch is the non-interactive vehicle that needs NO gate-disabling and NO dialog-answering — the clean headless path, sidestepping the interactive gate entirely. Phase 5's dispatch design should target the container vehicle, not tmux/local. (4) DEPENDENCY: the working vehicle needs the agent image pullable — forecast-bio/crosslink#576 (CLOSED; publication state to confirm before relying on it). (5) Upstream's recommended fix: make kickoff plan non-interactive OR add --container to plan. Entry-1 trigger_context corrected on feat/820 (e2cb2ca1) to reflect this; predicate/status unchanged. This is a strong argument to REVISIT the consent-posture decision toward 'container vehicle, no gate-disabling.'
